title: Page Spec
description: Declarative spec for /webapp-feature when scaffolding a non-trivial page (list, detail, or form). Replaces the inline 10-question interview with a reviewable, autocompleted YAML file. SCOPE — Phase 1: list / detail / form pages that consume EXISTING backend endpoints (Mode A). Phase 1 explicitly does NOT cover: dashboards (multi-widget grids), wizards (multi-step flows), pages that need new backend work (use /full-stack-feature instead), animations / pixel layout (use Figma + @mma/ui variants).

route.description: Next.js App Router path. Examples: /payments, /payments/[paymentId], /admin/discounts. Dynamic segments use [paramName].

segment.description: public = lives under apps/webapp/src/app/. protected = lives under apps/webapp/src/app/(protected)/ — adds auth middleware redirect.

title.description: Human-readable page title shown in <h1> and document <title>. Optional — defaults to the last route segment in Title Case.

layout.description: Phase 1 layouts only. list = table + filter bar + create button. detail = single-record cards + action menu. form = create/edit form. For dashboards / wizards / custom layouts, use the chat-box interview instead.

permissions.description: Optional role-gated access. Enforced both client-side (hide UI) and server-side (the API itself must validate).

roles.description: User roles permitted to view this page. Values must come from USER_ROLES in @mma/contracts/user.

navigation.description: Optional sidebar navigation entry. Omit for pages that should not appear in the sidebar (detail pages, modals).

section.description: Sidebar section header. Examples: Operations, Finance, Admin.

icon.description: lucide-react icon name (kebab-case). Examples: dollar-sign, users, package.

order.description: Sort order within the section. Lower = higher in the list.

domain.description: Lowercase, kebab-case domain name. Drives the components/{domain}/ folder, the contract import (@mma/contracts/{domain}), and the per-domain status formatter (formatXxxStatus from @mma/client-common).

dataSources.description: React Query hooks the page consumes. ALL hooks must already exist in @mma/client-common — if any are missing, /webapp-feature stops in Mode B and redirects to /new-feature. Phase 1 only supports Mode A.

states.description: Loading / error / empty states. The orchestrator scaffolds the matching loading.tsx, error.tsx, and empty-state component automatically.

loading.description: Loading state shape. skeleton-* variants render a domain-specific skeleton. spinner is a generic fallback.

error.description: Error boundary style. segment-error renders the shared <SegmentError> component (always-correct default).

message.description: Empty-state copy. Example: 'No payments yet — record your first one.'

action.description: Action key — must match a form name (e.g. open-form:create-payment) or an action from `actions` (e.g. action:approve).

components.description: Domain components rendered on the page. Phase 1 supports kind=data-table, kind=detail-card, kind=filter-bar. Other shapes (custom rendering, charts, kanban) drop back to the chat-box interview.

forms.description: react-hook-form + Zod resolver forms on this page. Schemas MUST come from @mma/contracts/{domain} — never duplicate.

actions.description: Status-driven action buttons. Each action maps a status (or set of statuses) to a mutation hook + button label. Used for detail-page action menus AND list-row inline actions.

testIds.description: Required data-testid attributes for Playwright + RTL. The orchestrator emits these into the generated components and references them in apps/webapp-e2e/src/utils/selectors.ts.

items.description: Kebab-case selector. Use {param} for dynamic segments (e.g. payment-row-{paymentId}).

figma.description: OPTIONAL reference to a Figma frame for layout / appearance. The orchestrator queries the Figma Dev MCP server (when configured) to align component slot order, spacing, and colors with the design. Page STRUCTURE remains owned by this YAML — Figma owns appearance only.

fileKey.description: Optional Figma file key. Defaults to the workspace-wide FIGMA_FILE_KEY env var.

hook.description: Hook name from @mma/client-common. Examples: usePaymentsByStatus, usePayment, useCustomers.

args.description: Arguments expression as it appears in the call site. Examples: '{ status, cursor }', 'paymentId', 'undefined'.

purpose.description: Optional one-line description of what this hook provides. Used in generated JSDoc.

name.description: PascalCase component name. Examples: PaymentsTable, PaymentDetailCard, PaymentFilters.

kind.description: Phase 1 component shapes. data-table → uses <DataTable> primitive (sortable, selectable). detail-card → key/value rows. filter-bar → status select + search input.

rowKey.description: REQUIRED for kind=data-table. Field name to use as React key for each row. Usually the entity's primary key (e.g. paymentId).

rowLink.description: Optional row click target for kind=data-table. Supports {fieldName} interpolation. Example: /payments/{paymentId}.

columns.description: REQUIRED for kind=data-table. One entry per column.

rowActions.description: Optional inline-row action names for kind=data-table. Each name MUST match an action in `actions` (e.g. ['refund', 'cancel']).

fields.description: REQUIRED for kind=detail-card. Key/value pairs to render.

filters.description: REQUIRED for kind=filter-bar. One entry per filter input.

field.description: Property name on the row entity. Examples: paymentId, amount, status.

format.description: Display format. text = raw string. currency = $X.XX. date = locale date. truncate = first 8 chars + '...'. Default: text.

badge.description: Optional badge variant function name from apps/webapp/src/lib/status-variants.ts. Example: paymentStatusVariant. Only used when the column renders a status enum.

formatter.description: Optional format helper from @mma/client-common. REQUIRED if the column renders a status enum (Golden Rule #22a). Examples: formatPaymentStatus, formatOrderStatus.

sortable.description: Phase 1 default: true for data-table columns.

align.description: Cell alignment. Default: left (right for numeric / currency).

label.description: Label shown next to the value.

badge.description: Optional badge variant function name (status fields only).

formatter.description: Optional format*Status helper from @mma/client-common (REQUIRED for status fields — Golden Rule #22a).

name.description: camelCase URL-search-param name. Becomes ?name=value in the route.

type.description: Phase 1 filter inputs. select = dropdown. search = debounced text input. daterange = two date pickers.

source.description: REQUIRED for type=select. Enum constant name from @mma/contracts/{domain}. Example: PaymentStatusEnum.

label.description: Display label. Defaults to Title Case of `name`.

name.description: kebab-case form identifier. Used in testIds, file names, and `cta.action` references. Example: create-payment.

schema.description: Zod schema name from @mma/contracts/{domain}. MUST already exist — never duplicate. Example: createPaymentSchema.

trigger.description: How the form is presented. button = inline section on the page. modal = opens in a Dialog. route = its own page (only valid when page.layout=form).

title.description: Form title shown in modal header or page <h2>.

fields.description: Form input fields. Each field corresponds to a key in the Zod schema. Phase 1 supports text/number/select/textarea/combobox/checkbox/daterange.

redirect.description: Optional route to redirect to after submit. Supports {field} interpolation from the response. Example: /payments/{id}.

closeModal.description: If trigger=modal, close the modal on success. Default: true.

toast.description: Error toast message. Defaults to 'Something went wrong.' (the API error message is ALSO shown via FormMessage).

name.description: camelCase field name. MUST match a key in the Zod schema.

type.description: Input shape. select / combobox require `source`. combobox is a searchable async select.

label.description: Field label. Defaults to Title Case of `name`.

source.description: REQUIRED for type=select | combobox. Either an enum constant name (PaymentStatusEnum) or a hook name (useCustomers — for combobox).

optional.description: Marks the field as optional in the UI (must also be optional in the Zod schema).

helperText.description: Helper text shown below the input.

name.description: kebab-case action identifier. Used in components.rowActions and empty.cta.action.

from.description: Status enum values from which this action is allowed. The button is hidden when the entity status is not in this list. Example: [PENDING, APPROVED].

confirm.description: If true, wraps the action in an <AlertDialog> confirmation. Recommended for destructive actions.

confirmMessage.description: Custom confirmation prompt. Defaults to 'Are you sure?'.

opensForm.description: Optional form name from `forms`. If set, clicking the action opens that form (in a modal) instead of calling the hook directly. Useful for actions that need extra input (e.g. refund amount).

intent.description: Button variant. destructive renders red. Default: secondary.
